verdict.rationale: The product has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. Natural-language operation is possible indirectly: the hosted platform MCP endpoint exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split and Index as tools any MCP client can call, so an external agent can drive them from natural-language requests. Several individual features also accept natural-language input: Classify rules, custom parsing prompts, and prompt-generated extraction schemas. Missing for 10: a first-party chat or command interface for operating the platform, NL control that does not depend on a third-party MCP client, and hands-on or independent corroboration of driving the product conversationally.
